name: Xonotic
description: Free and open-source arena FPS (Quake lineage). Official release zip downloaded from dl.xonotic.org.

install.command: cp -r Xonotic/* . && rm -rf Xonotic && chmod +x xonotic-linux64-dedicated

variables.label: Xonotic version
variables.description: Release version used in the download URL (dl.xonotic.org). Re-run install after changing it.

notes: The release zip is ~1 GB and nests everything under Xonotic/ — the install copies it into the server root. The dedicated binary automatically executes data/server.cfg on startup. The console accepts commands on stdin (status, endmatch, quit). Xonotic uses the DarkPlaces rcon protocol (rcon_password cvar), which is not Source RCON compatible.
